notes.title: RunVR 1.06
notes.content:
[*] You can now jump off of walls you are wall running by using the jump button.
[*] Grabbing/wall running counts as touching the floor for your jump cooldown.
[*] Added Giga-size option. For players that want an easier time grabbing/throwing themselves across levels or if they're physically too short. Highscores are disabled while giga-size is on.
[*] Reworked some earlier levels to have more hazards.
[*] Added double jump tutorial.
[*] You can now exit out of levels by holding 3 buttons for 4 seconds.

notes.title: RunVR 1.06
notes.content:
[*] You can now jump off of walls you are wall running by using the jump button.
[*] Grabbing/wall running counts as touching the floor for your jump cooldown.
[*] Added Giga-size option. For players that want an easier time grabbing/throwing themselves across levels or if they're physically too short. Highscores are disabled while giga-size is on.
[*] Reworked some earlier levels to have more hazards.
[*] Added double jump tutorial.
[*] You can now exit out of levels by holding 3 buttons for 4 seconds.

[*] Workshop added to the game. You can now upload folders containing levels.
[*] Giles in game Level editor added to the game. You can now create/edit levels and save them in to a json format. Remember to take off your headset when using the level editor.
[*] Fixed fast falling occurring if you grabbed something while fast falling.
[*] Mostly fixed getting stuck in waist high ground.
[*] Fixed twisting your hand causing you to fall.

Also added video tutorial on how to use RunVR's Giles Level Editor to youtube. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gq0Y0Ox_3I8

Another update for you all this week! Notable changes:
[list]
    [*]Modified movement values, most notable, gravity’s scale and thrusting force, causing faster falls and more exaggerated throws.
    [*]Systematic improvements to player collision so that edge collisions will reconcile cleaner.
    [*]Running into objects will not trigger the ‘invisible force’ as easily.
    [*]Throwing yourself on top of areas should be easier.
    [*]Added a blob shadow for the headset. Shows where you will land.
    [*]Added an interface to change audio levels. 
    [*]Minor revisions to some levels.
[/list]

notes.title: First Patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added new feature of loading in to the correct position. Starting RunVR again will load you into the HUB world if you already entered the HUB world.
[*]Entering the HUB world again will position you in front of the level you just exited.
[*]Added VFX for climbing/wall running.
[list]
